newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.150 cent. Expect higher cash cattle market, boxed beef higher Friday and technically strong after new contract highs Friday.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Follow live cattle with corn calls weak but index was lower.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Cash hog calls mostly steady to instances higher but futures up to technical resistance and cooler weather may increase runs during week.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Product steady but futures gains overdone late last week. July expires today.
